name: Play Sound at Location
description: Plays a spatialized sound asset at a world-space position so it attenuates with distance. Useful for diegetic sounds such as explosions, footsteps, and ambient emitters.

inputs.name: World Context Object
inputs.description: Object used to resolve the world. Usually self or hidden when called from an actor.

inputs.name: Sound
inputs.description: The sound asset to play. Connect a Sound Wave, Sound Cue, or MetaSound Source reference.

inputs.name: Location
inputs.description: World-space position to play the sound at. The sound attenuates with distance from this point.

inputs.name: Rotation
inputs.description: Rotation of the sound. Used for panning and 3D orientation of the audio source.

inputs.name: Volume Multiplier
inputs.description: Multiplier on the sound's volume (1.0 = default, 0.0 = silent, 2.0 = double).

inputs.name: Pitch Multiplier
inputs.description: Multiplier on the sound's pitch (1.0 = default, 2.0 = double pitch / octave up, 0.5 = half).

inputs.name: Start Time
inputs.description: Offset into the sound asset to start playing at, in seconds. Useful for skipping the intro of long sounds.

inputs.name: Attenuation Settings
inputs.description: Optional attenuation override for falloff and spatialization behavior. Leave empty to use the sound's defaults.

inputs.name: Concurrency Settings
inputs.description: Optional concurrency rules (max instances, etc.) to limit how many copies of this sound can play simultaneously.

inputs.name: Owning Actor
inputs.description: Optional owning actor. Used for cleanup tracking and to associate the sound with an actor for memory management.

outputs.name: Out
outputs.description: Execution pin that fires immediately after the play call is dispatched. The sound itself continues to play in the background.
